name: Does pool removal increase property value in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: Will removing an in-ground pool increase a home’s resale value in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank?
mainEntity.text: Will removing an in-ground pool increase a home’s resale value in Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, or Burbank?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing a pool can help resale value when buyers prefer a larger, low-maintenance yard or want space for an outdoor living area, ADU, or addition. It can hurt value if the neighborhood strongly favors pools or if the home is in a market where a pool is expected. In Los Angeles-area luxury and family neighborhoods, the impact depends on buyer expectations, lot size, and whether the finished yard looks intentional and well designed. A badly finished fill-in can reduce appeal, while a clean landscape redesign can improve it. Homeowners should think about their target buyer and compare the value of a usable yard against the appeal of an existing pool. If the home is likely to sell soon, the quality of the final grading, drainage, and landscaping matters almost as much as the demolition itself.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pool removal can increase value for some buyers by creating more usable yard space, reducing maintenance, and improving flexibility for future use. It can also hurt value if buyers want a pool, especially in warmer or luxury neighborhoods. The effect depends on the neighborhood, lot size, home type, and how the new yard is finished.
